label: Accounting and Bookkeeping Team
blurb: A Controller and 4 specialists who organize business records, invoices, payroll inputs, and tax paperwork
purpose: Designed for business owners, leaders, and teams executing on accounting and bookkeeping. Organize business records, invoices, payroll inputs, and tax paperwork. The team coordinates research, analysis, operational planning, and structured deliverables to drive measurable results.
